narrative.intro: Mission Support and Test Services has $953M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Mission Support and Test Services recorded 4 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $238M. Obligations are down 4.2% year over year. Historical obligations show variation: FY21 had $855M, FY22 had $923M, FY23 had $838M, FY24 had $1.1B, FY25 had $995M, and FY26 has $953M to date. The Department of Energy is the primary buyer, accounting for $953M in FY2026 to date. The General Services Administration appears with $61.2K in obligations. Facilities Support Services is the top NAICS market with $953M in obligations, while General Automotive Repair shows $61.2K. The note on accounting: figures on this page are contract obligations, except where tables list award-value or expiring-contract totals as total contract values. Current-year totals are partial because they cover the fiscal year to date. This summary focuses on where obligations are concentrated and how FY2026 to date compares with prior years.
